narr: Scattered thunderstorms in late June produced isolated damaging winds and flash flooding.
ev: A few vehicles were stranded in street flooding along Thornhill Drive.
Hardy Street from 31st Avenue to 38th Avenue was flooded, and three vehicles were stranded in floodwaters beneath the 4th Street bridge.
